scope: Outcome-blind execution of the three lightweight Wave 2 tasks in the frozen 30-task proportional checkpoint

checkpoint_design.selection_rule: Preserve every task selected in the previously frozen Wave 2 sentinel tranche 2; split execution only by declared sandbox resources.
checkpoint_design.revision_reason: The task manifests declare 1 CPU and 2 GiB for these three tasks, which fits the empirically safe three-sandbox Daytona ceiling.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: one four-route task batch at a time, at most three concurrent trials, followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Complete all three tasks before using their outcomes to choose follow-on tasks. Infrastructure failures remain excluded and are recovered route-for-route.
